看来.why: Standard mainland reading is kànlái (现代汉语词典); 来 keeps its 2nd tone, CC-CEDICT's neutral 'lai' is non-standard

土地.why: HSK sense 'land' is tǔdì; the neutral-tone tǔdi is only the earth-god sense (土地神)

吓.why: HSK5 吓 'to frighten/scare' is xià; hè is the literary reading used only in 恐吓/恫吓

抢.why: 'to rob, to snatch' is qiǎng (3rd tone); qiāng is a rare reading (抢风, 呼天抢地)

薄.why: HSK5 薄 'thin (of flat things)' is the colloquial reading báo; bó is the literary/compound reading (薄弱, 单薄)

学问.why: 现代汉语词典 and the HSK list give xué·wen with neutral-tone 问

下载.why: Prescribed mainland reading is xiàzài (载 'to carry/load' is zài); xiàzǎi is a widespread but non-standard pronunciation

系领带.why: 系 'to tie/fasten' is jì, not xì (department/system)

干活儿.why: Malformed erhua: 'gàn huó r 5' should be gàn huór (r attached to 活, no separate tone)

使劲儿.why: Malformed erhua: 'shǐ jìn r 5' should be shǐ jìnr
